Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for registering for social assistance programs and accessing social services
Comments: The World Bank assessment confirms that social protection programmes (VFP, pensions; ~3,080 beneficiaries) use ID/civil documents for beneficiary registration in systems such as SIIPS/CORE-MIS. A National Social Protection Identification (NIS/NSIPI) is issued for the social registry. ID is accepted but the system has duplicate issues due to lack of a unique national ID. Scored 2 (Accepted, not yet fully mandatory/integrated).
